events.subtitle: Bespoke Laborde Chansonnier program in the Great Hall
events.factual_description: The Library of Congress presents Antwerp-based period vocal ensemble Graindelavoix on Friday, November 20, 2026 at 20:00 in the Thomas Jefferson Building's Great Hall, with a 18:30 preconcert conversation with the artists in the Whittall Pavilion. The concert is free but ticketed. The Library describes a bespoke program dramatizing the dawn of print culture through works drawn from the Music Division's Renaissance collections, including the Laborde Chansonnier. Graindelavoix's official site describes the ensemble, founded in 1999 and helmed by founder-director Björn Schmelzer, as committed to contemporary and critical interpretation of mainly historical vocal repertoires. The date-specific individual singers are not named in the checked event source and are therefore not inferred.

en.why_it_matters: The archive is part of the music here, not background scenery. Graindelavoix is bringing its deliberately contemporary, critical way of singing historical repertoire into a bespoke program built from the Library's Laborde Chansonnier and other Renaissance treasures, then putting that material into the Great Hall rather than treating it as a museum exercise. It is an unusually direct collision between old source material, a living interpretive philosophy and the room that holds the collection.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for this if November 20 is open and get there for the 6:30 conversation if possible. It is a local Washington night with enough archive and performance identity to build the evening around; there is no need to turn it into a regional trip.

es.why_it_matters: Aquí el archivo sí forma parte de la música. Graindelavoix llega con una manera deliberadamente contemporánea y crítica de cantar repertorio histórico y con un programa armado a partir del Laborde Chansonnier y otros tesoros renacentistas de la propia Library. La gracia no es escuchar 'música antigua' como pieza de museo, sino oír cómo un ensamble vivo y bastante incómodo con las convenciones se enfrenta al material en el edificio que lo conserva.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 20 de noviembre está libre, sí haría espacio y trataría de llegar a la conversación de las 6:30. Es una noche local en Washington con suficiente identidad de archivo y de interpretación para construir la tarde alrededor de ella; no hace falta convertirla en viaje regional.
